title: Uniqueness of four-body convex central configurations for all masses
summary: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of Theorems A and B of arXiv:2609.35632 on the central configurations of the planar Newtonian four-body problem. For every choice of four positive masses and every cyclic order of the bodies there is exactly one strictly convex central configuration with that cyclic order, up to similarity, so there are exactly three convex central configurations up to similarity.
